description: This file contains a single function toggleOfflineClientInstallation that manages the enabled/disabled state of form fields related to offline client installation based on a checkbox. The file includes licensing and attribution comments relevant to SuiteCRM and SugarCRM projects.

methods.name: toggleOfflineClientInstallation()
methods.description: A JavaScript function that toggles the disabled state of form inputs for server URL, username, and password based on whether the oc_install checkbox is checked or not.
